name: Synfynal Connector for Business Central
author: Synfynal

sections.description:
Synfynal Connector for Business Central connects your WooCommerce store to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Your products, stock and prices come from Business Central, every web order arrives there as a sales order, and nobody types anything twice.

It is the store side of the WooCommerce Connector on Microsoft AppSource, Synfynal’s app for Business Central. More than 80 companies run their stores on Business Central with it, and its users rate it 5 out of 5 there.

What stays in sync

  • Products. The items you choose in Business Central become products in your store, with their variants, categories, attributes, prices and stock, and they stay up to date.
  • Orders. A web order arrives in Business Central as a sales order with the right customer, the lines, tax, shipping, fees, coupons and the payment method. Refunds arrive as return orders, and posting an order in Business Central completes it in the store.
  • Customers. Web buyers are matched to the customers you already have, or created from a template. Guest orders are handled too.
  • Several stores. One Business Central company can supply several WooCommerce stores, each with its own items, prices and order rules.
  • A log you can read. Business Central records every synchronized record with its result. A failure names the record and what the store answered, and is retried.

Synchronization runs on a schedule you set, and you manage every store from Business Central.

B2B prices from Business Central price lists

This plugin gives WooCommerce the pricing a wholesale store needs, and Business Central fills it:

  • Every customer sees their own price after signing in: on the product page, in the cart and at checkout.
  • Price lists as you keep them in Business Central: for all customers, one customer, a customer price group or a customer discount group, with quantity breaks, line discounts and starting and ending dates.
  • Customer groups follow. Each customer’s price group and discount group come from Business Central.
  • One price, explained. The Price preview screen shows the price a customer gets for a product, which rule won and why every other rule lost.
  • Your staff can work in the store too. Create price lists in wp-admin beside the ones from Business Central, and send them back to Business Central if you want to. Lists made in the store cannot be changed through the API without an explicit override; store edits to lists sent from Business Central can be overwritten by the next synchronization.
  • Orders keep their prices. A placed order keeps what it was charged; refunds use those amounts, never today’s rules.

How it works

There are two parts, and you get them in two places:

  1. The WooCommerce Connector app, in Business Central, from Microsoft AppSource. It does the synchronizing through the WooCommerce REST API.
  2. This plugin, in your store. It adds what the REST API does not have: B2B price lists, customer groups from Business Central, and product translations for stores that use Polylang. It also tells Business Central what your store supports, so a missing update is named before it causes an error.

What it costs

  • This plugin is free and open source (GPLv2 or later). Nothing in it is locked behind a payment.
  • The WooCommerce Connector app is a subscription. It is free in a Business Central sandbox for as long as you need, and your production environment gets a 15-day free trial. After that it costs from $60 a month (up to 50 orders and refunds a month) to $250 a month (more than 500). Every tier includes every feature.
  • Add-ons such as B2B Price List Sync, Image Synchronization and Metadata Synchronization are billed separately.

See pricing on synfynal.com for the current plans.

Start your free trial

Get the WooCommerce Connector on Microsoft AppSource and choose Free trial. Its assisted setup asks for your store’s address and a REST API key, and the first orders arrive in Business Central within minutes. Prefer a guided start? Book a demo or a setup session.

What you need

  • WooCommerce 7.9 or later; price lists need WooCommerce 8.0.
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Essential or Premium, with the WooCommerce Connector app.
  • For price lists: the connector’s B2B Price List Sync add-on, and Business Central’s new sales pricing experience turned on.

Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart and Checkout Blocks. With Polylang and the connector’s Multilingual Support add-on, product updates from Business Central are copied to the product’s translations.

Privacy

The plugin sends nothing to any other service. Business Central reads and writes your store through the WooCommerce REST API, with an API key you create.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce 7.9 or later; price lists need 8.0.
  2. In Plugins > Add New Plugin, search for “Synfynal Connector for Business Central”, then install and activate it.
  3. In WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API, create a key with Read/Write permissions for an administrator.
  4. In Business Central, install the WooCommerce Connector from Microsoft AppSource and run its assisted setup with your store’s address and that key. The setup guide walks you through it.
  5. Choose the items for the store on the Webstore Item Mapping page and synchronize.

To send price lists as well:

  1. In the store, under WooCommerce > Settings > Pricing, make sure Enable Pricing module is on.
  2. In Business Central, on the WooCommerce Connector Feature Management page, turn on B2B Price List Sync. In the webstore setup, turn on Synchronize Price Lists, and set Price Lists under Push Data to Webstore to Mapped Only.
  3. Choose the price lists to send on the Webstore Price List Mapping page.
sections.faq:
Do I need Business Central?

To synchronize, yes: the plugin is the store side of the WooCommerce Connector app in Business Central. The price lists also work on their own: you can create them in wp-admin and they apply on the storefront.

Is it free, and can I try it first?

The plugin is free. The WooCommerce Connector app in Business Central is a subscription, with a 15-day free trial in production. In a Business Central sandbox it is free for as long as you need, add-ons included, so you can connect a staging copy of your store and try everything. See pricing.

What is synchronized, and in which direction?

Products, variants, categories, attributes, stock, prices, customers and coupons go from Business Central to the store, and can be read from the store into Business Central. Orders and refunds come into Business Central as sales orders and return orders. Images need the Image Synchronization add-on. You choose the direction for each kind of record.

Can one Business Central company run several stores?

Yes. Each store has its own connection, item selection, price lists and order rules, and you manage all of them from Business Central.

Which Business Central price lists can go to the store?

Sales price lists assigned to all customers, one customer, a customer price group or a customer discount group, without a currency, with prices excluding VAT and with lines for items, variants or item discount groups. Business Central tells you when you mark a price list that the store cannot represent, and why.

Will it change prices my catalog exports or other plugins read?

No. Price lists apply on the storefront, the Store API, and the cart and checkout only. The general product REST API, CSV exports, WP-CLI and wp-admin see the stored regular price.

I run version 1. What changes when I update?

Nothing you need to do: everything version 1.2.0 did keeps working. Update in place and do not delete version 1 first, because deleting it removes the customer roles data that Business Central relies on. Version 2 needs PHP 8.1 and WordPress 6.7.

Where do I get help?

The Synfynal help center covers the WooCommerce Connector and this plugin. For questions about the plugin, use the support forum here.
sections.changelog:
2.0.1

  • Fixed: the plugin includes its license, LICENSE.txt with the GPLv2 text, again.

2.0.0

  • New: B2B price lists and rules for all customers, one customer or a customer group, with quantity tiers, discount classes, date windows, a price preview and a REST API.
  • New: Business Central can read the plugin’s version and what the store supports, to tell you what to fix.
  • Everything 1.2.0 did works as before.
  • Changed: the plugin is now called Synfynal Connector for Business Central. Its slug, settings and data stay as they are.
  • Changed: deactivating no longer deletes the customer roles data, and uninstalling deletes data only when “Delete data on uninstall” is on.
  • Changed: the connector can no longer give a customer a role with admin rights, such as shop manager or editor, or change a user who has them.
  • Changed: requires PHP 8.1, WordPress 6.7 and WooCommerce. Price lists need WooCommerce 8.0.

1.2.0

  • The Polylang sync also copies a product’s categories to its translations, using each category’s translation where one exists.

1.0 to 1.1.7

  • Customer roles for Business Central, the connector’s REST endpoints and the Polylang product sync.
